stance_basis: cited as data source for water quality monitoring and standards, no position expressed on the project
summary: The Illinois Environmental Protection Agency is referenced in the EIS as a source of water quality data and regulatory standards, not as a commenting party. The document cites the Agency's long-running Water Quality Sampling Program (since 1958) and reproduces excerpts from its 1973 Water Quality Network Summary of Data for the Des Plaines River Basin, including data for Thorn Creek and Butterfield Creek relevant to the project area. The Agency does not express a position for or against the project in this window.
complaint_summary: The Illinois EPA and its predecessor are described as having conducted a water quality sampling program since 1958, and the Illinois Pollution Control Board's 1972 Water Quality Standards are cited as the regulatory framework applicable to the project area's streams.
summary_quote: The Illinois Environmental Protection Agency and its predecessor, the Stream Pollution Control Bureau of the Department of Public Health, have carried out a program of regular sampling of the streams and lakes of Illinois since 1958.

mentions.quote: The Illinois Environmental Protection Agency and its predecessor, the Stream Pollution Control Bureau of the Department of Public Health, have carried out a program of regular sampling of the streams and lakes of Illinois since 1958.
The review indicates that the proposal does not conflict with any of the plans, programs, or priorities of any cognizant State agency.
